mapper.delete: delete from mfa_tickets where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and (expires_at < now() or created_at < now() - interval '1 hour')
mapper.insert: insert into mfa_tickets (id, user_id, tenant_id, kind, via, expires_at) values (#{id}, cast(#{uid} as uuid), #{tid}, #{kind}, #{via}, now() + interval '5 minutes')
mapper.update: update mfa_tickets set code_hash = #{h}, code_exp = now() + interval '10 minutes', sent_at = now(), sends = sends + 1, expires_at = greatest(expires_at, now() + interval '5 minutes') where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select t.user_id::text as user_id, t.tenant_id, t.kind, t.via, t.code_hash, t.tries, (t.code_exp > now()) as live, u.email from mfa_tickets t join users u on u.id = t.user_id where t.id = #{id} and t.expires_at > now() and t.tries < 5

select t.kind, t.sends, t.tenant_id, (t.sent_at > now() - interval '30 seconds') as soon, u.email from mfa_tickets t join users u on u.id = t.user_id where t.id = #{id} and t.expires_at > now() and t.tries < 5
update mfa_tickets set tries = tries + 1 where id = #{id} returning tries
select secret, pend, last_step from user_totp where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
mapper.update: update user_totp set last_step = #{st}, updated_at = now() where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) and last_step < #{st}
mapper.insert: insert into user_totp (user_id, pend) values (cast(#{uid} as uuid), #{pend}) on conflict (user_id) do update set pend = excluded.pend, updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update user_totp set secret = pend, pend = '', last_step = #{st}, on_at = now(), updated_at = now() where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
mapper.select: delete from user_totp where user_id = cast(#{uid} as uuid) returning secret
select doc->'org'->'sec'->>'mfa' from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select name from tenants where id = #{tid}
select pw from users where id = cast(#{uid} as uuid)
